safety_boundaries.finding: REAL_WINDOWS execution is hard-blocked by assertResourceExecutionQualified before native prepare and in QualificationGate. Only SIMULATED is admitted; certificate, Feature, Policy, config, timeout or CPU_RATE cannot override failed cumulative CPU capability.
Legacy ExecutionBroker always rejects arbitrary dispatch. RuntimeControl admits only PURE/READ_ONLY contract consumption and returns execution BLOCKED; release always rejects without full OS profile.

Trusted bootstrap requires distinct standard Host/Worker/Operator identities, exact external config and source/executable hashes, protected owner/group/DACL pins and native peer tuple/image/token rechecks. Test primitive IDs cannot become production IDs.

Grant/approval/resource consumption is durable before start; final fences recheck identity, epochs, peer, feature and audit state. Disconnect, consumed uncertainty and restart quarantine resources and prohibit automatic replay.

Root exit or terminate request is insufficient. Exit release needs complete rooted member history, tree empty, producer EOF, artifact verification, native sandbox observations, independent adjudication, owner closure and version-bound acknowledgement. WindowsSupervisor conservatively leaves network/filesystem/limits unverified.

File paths are constrained and native opens retain directory handles, reject reparse/hardlinks and bind content/file versions. Operations are bounded and create-only; this is not a general hostile-process filesystem sandbox or disk quota.
Ubuntu is preparation-only and explicitly BLOCKED; SO_PEERCRED alone grants no runtime or execution authority.

fixed_runner_reuse_recommendations: Use an explicit immutable allow-list of runner IDs, exact executable/code hashes, fixed argv construction and a trusted fixed working directory. Agent input must not select shell, executable, script, cwd or arbitrary module loading.

Reuse exact input/resource/task/operation binding, canonical snapshots, consumed-before-start ledgers, audit barriers and one-operation lifetimes; label execution LOCAL_TRUSTED_LIBRARY / FIXED_RUNNER without upgrading OS qualification.
Sanitize environment with an explicit allow-list. Historical verify runners spread process.env; their test harness behavior is not an approved credential boundary for a new runner.

Keep output outside candidate source using realpath/case-aware existing-ancestor resolution as in output-root.ts. That validation is useful for engineering outputs but does not establish hostile-process containment or eliminate path races.

Pin Node v24.15.0 / TypeScript 5.9.3 / @types-node 24.10.1 and explicitly locate existing tools. WindowsApps PowerShell path behavior can differ; keep executable hash and tool-path observations separate from OS account/ACL qualification.

Do not invoke verify-m161 --suite all during read-only Phase0: dynamic .test.ts discovery includes native Job, CPU and TOCTOU fixtures. A later approved fixed runner needs an explicit profile and separately reported inherited FAILs.

Do not run catalog-m16.py or package-m12.py to prepare M1.7: they mutate old config/source or release paths. Create append-only M1.7 manifests, packages and evidence, preserving every old file and failure.

Do not release old Gateway/Worker/UNKNOWN reservations because a local file was reconciled. New runner cancellation/deadline/owner death must retain uncertainty until its actual trusted owner proves settlement.
